instruction: Acquire a lock in etcd with etcdctl
output:
etcdctl lock mylock 'echo "critical section running"'
mylock/1234567890abcdef
critical section running

instruction: Execute a transaction in etcd with etcdctl
output:
etcdctl txn <<'EOF'
compare:
  value("/config/app/version") = "2"
success:
  put /config/app/version "3"
failure:
  put /config/app/version-error "mismatch"
EOF
SUCCESS

/config/app/version
3

instruction: Test a transaction in etcd that should fail
output:
etcdctl txn <<'EOF'
compare:
  value("/config/app/version") = "99"
success:
  put /config/app/version "100"
failure:
  put /config/app/version-error "expected version 99, got 3"
EOF
FAILURE

/config/app/version-error
expected version 99, got 3

instruction: Grant a new lease in etcd with etcdctl
output:
etcdctl lease grant 60
lease 1234567890abcdef granted with TTL(60s)

instruction: Revoke a lease in etcd with etcdctl
output:
etcdctl lease revoke 1234567890abcdef
lease 1234567890abcdef revoked

instruction: Keep a lease alive in etcd with etcdctl
output:
etcdctl lease keep-alive 1234567890abcdef
lease 1234567890abcdef keepalived with TTL(60)
lease 1234567890abcdef keepalived with TTL(60)
...
